candidate.compatibilitySourceDifference: Only the release-managed extensionVersion literal in easyeda-bridge-extension/src/index.ts differs between main and the candidate. The other five sensitive subtrees are byte-identical.

observations.scenario: Authenticated Cloud MCP READ and selected-project boundary
observations.details: Real EasyEDA V4.1.105 + Bridge 1.16.1 selected page P1; correctly targeted sheet read and project list succeeded. A deliberately different project ID returned PROJECT_INACTIVE for sheet metadata and components after 6067401 was deployed.

observations.scenario: Native scoped WRITE on deployed source and exact rebuild-matching extension
observations.details: Remote MCP easyeda_schematic_add_text on focused P1 required a visible native Remote MCP Approval dialog. Normal UI Approve was selected. The exact retried call returned success:true and a primitive ID; new QA annotation was visually confirmed in the schematic.

Ctrl+S in native V4.1.105; disposable project SQLite integrity_check returned ok, file SHA-256 a576680cee9fa4df75909a06323f4dac03511804b52940d076ef455450a1dde6. Closed the QA-owned CLI editor session with session close --destroy true, reopened the same file with official CLI open --path, and opened P1; the newly written annotation was visible after reload.

observations.scenario: Native Bridge extension discovery after restart
observations.details: Official V4 functions --session inventory included enabled MCP Pro Bridge version 1.16.1. Rebuilt extension from PR #1084 candidate matched earlier installed and live-tested .eext byte-for-byte.

observations.scenario: Automatic Cloud recovery after editor cold restart
observations.details: After the new native editor session, the remote MCP call failed closed with SESSION_DISCONNECTED. Manual Connect Cloud opened the official one-time pairing-code prompt; no code was supplied. Neither automatic reconnection nor another successful post-restart remote call is claimed.

limitations: This record combines real native V4 executions on the 1.16.0 deployed Cloud source with a byte-identical 1.16.1 extension artifact from exact release candidate. The server v1.16.1 was NOT deployed as part of this test; the tracked release promotion changes only extensionVersion among sensitive source paths.
Direct independent-owner OAuth MCP denial, long network/token lifetime recovery, Google/GitHub credential rotation and fully unattended new-user onboarding are still unverified.
Manufacturing, PCB electrical correctness, zone writing and unrelated native workflows were not tested.
This record uses a verified version-literal-only release promotion from deployed main source to the release PR, not a claim that 1.16.1 server metadata was already deployed.
